theme: Fitting a brain-like net onto limited cores
title: Cores Are Cheap, Spikes Are Not: Cluster-Aware Neuron-to-Core Mapping
strategies: round-robin spread every neuron across ALL available cores in id order, no packing, LPT-by-rate slot fill only for feasibility (trivial)
first-fit-decreasing bin-packing by neuron fanout to minimize the number of active cores, blind to which neurons talk to which (greedy / the trap)

capacity-capped heavy-edge agglomerative clustering (partition by connectivity, not by count) then pack whole clusters onto cores, accepting more idle capacity to keep intra-cluster traffic local (strong)
joint cluster-refinement + slot co-scheduling that also chases the free same-core-same-slot bonus for the heaviest remaining cross-core pairs (open ceiling, uncovered)
